about_blocks.text: Treatment Services Offered at Options Okanagan Treatment Center
about_blocks.html: Treatment Services Offered at Options Okanagan Treatment Center

about_blocks.text: Options Okanagan is a non profit residential treatment center that specializes in personalized alcohol and drug treatment plans. The treatment plans are designed to meet the individual’s personal needs whether it be residential care or outpatient treatment. The center believes firmly in 12-Step foundation and the BioPsychoSocial model of care. These methods are used to provide clients with a full range of treatments to help in their recovery. Using a holistic approach, clients will receive tailored treatment plans that are unique to the individual and address any co-occurring conditions one may have. Treatment can include individual and group therapy, family therapy, and more.

about_blocks.text: One of the unique features of the Options Okanagan Treatment Center is its focus on “Social Recovery and Development.” This philosophy is about learning new ways to have fun, choosing new friends wisely, and selecting things that are important to the client’s life. It also includes activities such as hiking, yoga, and meditation to encourage a healthy lifestyle. In addition to treatment, Options Okanagan provides an extensive aftercare program that includes support and counseling from licensed addiction and family therapists. Clients are able to access counsellors anywhere and anytime via Skype, FaceTime Messenger, or Zoom.

about_blocks.html: Locations of Options Okanagan Treatment Center

about_blocks.text: Options Okanagan Treatment Center has 2 locations, one in Shuswap, Canada and the other in Kelowna, Canada. The facilities are tailored to provide clients with a comfortable and safe environment to aid in their rehabilitation process.

about_blocks.text: The facility in Shuswap immerses clients in nature by providing a cabin-like experience surrounded by the beautiful forest. Group meetings are held in a yurt that seems high above the treetops. Also, there is a dry sauna on site and plenty of space to hike or take meditative walks. The natural surroundings provide clients with an opportunity to relax and focus on their recovery.

about_blocks.text: Options Okanagan Treatment Center- Center Overview
about_blocks.html: Options Okanagan Treatment Center- Center Overview

about_blocks.text: Options Okanagan Treatment Center is a private, residential facility located in beautiful Kelowna, British Columbia. With an emphasis on providing a safe, respectful, and loving environment, Options offers a unique approach to addiction recovery. The center is small with private rooms, offering clients a comfortable and private space for relaxation. The program consists of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy combined with an introduction to Twelve Step programs, with a focus on education about the disease of addiction and relapse prevention.

about_blocks.text: The staff at Options is highly experienced, with most having personal experience in long-term recovery from drugs and alcohol. They offer compassionate and personalized care to each client during their stay. Options emphasizes treating the mind, body, and spirit, with nutritious meals and a recovery-based yoga program. The center also offers a Virtual Aftercare Program and family counseling as part of their commitment to long-term recovery. An open-door policy for alumni ensures that they stay connected and supported as they continue their recovery.
